notes.title: Version 0.4.0
notes.content:
Changelog


Added Crystal Fish that jump out of the sea and normally drop a healing power crystals upon death.

Added Rainbow Crystal Fish that drops a random power crystal upon death.

Added "fish" power crystal that triggers a "fish mania" for 15 seconds.

Added lite controller support. (Can seamlessly use a controller in-game but not navigate menus; may expand functionality in the future if demand necessitates it.)

Added two new enemies to tease the next 2 major updates. (Can be encountered in Endless Mode (Unlocked after reaching the final boss.).)

Increased FOV.

Standardized Basic Cubes to all shoot 1 big laser blast with same amount of damage.

Changed Black Cubes to 2 laser blasts.

Changed Black Cube laser blasts to be easier to see.

Changed 'Time of Day' to continue from last death.

Reduced damage of main lasers by 33.33%.

Increased damage multiplier applied on charged blast from red power crystal by 150%.

Adjusted power-up sound effect.

Adjusted missile trails to be a lighter color.

Adjusted lock-on laser effect to be more transparent.

Fixed other entities triggering under water sound effect.

Fixed damage indicator flash inconsistency issue.

Updated game to Unreal Engine 5.5.4.

Updated version indicator to v.0.4.0.


Please use the discussion feature of this post to notify me of any issues and/or thoughts on this update.

Thank you for playing Hyper_Sea_5000,
tofeelpain.
